title: 環境土木工学入門とキャリアデザイン
subtitle: Introduction to Civil and Environmental Engineering and Career Design
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) understand connection between civil engineering and society, (2) understand history of technology, (3) understand academic area of civil and environmental engineering, (4) plan their course of study considering career formation to accomplish their dreams.
advice:
This is a basic course of study for civil and environmental engineering. We will cover the following materials:

1. Understanding of system in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (GX)
2. Understanding of outline in Civil and Environmental Engineering
3. Development of scientific capabilities that logically consider the essence of phenomena and conditions
4. Introduction of fields to academic and research

Students are required to actively participate in class.

This is useful for all subjects, in particular Design in Civil and Environmental Engineering.
requiredKnowledge: Selecting and finding of an area of interest in civil and environmental engineering.

activityGoals.body: Students can understand engineering’s role in contemporary society, and plan their own studies. [0.05A, 0.05I]
Students can understand the study area of civil and environmental engineering.  [0.1A, 0.1I]
Students can give a rough outline of the design, construction, and maintenance of structures. [0.2J]
Students can give a rough outline of the use of the natural environment (GX). [0.2K]
Students can give a rough outline about measurement, analysis, and evaluation of geoinformatics (DX). [0.2L]
Students can explain the process engineers follow as they create their own careers. [0.05A, 0.05I]
